realizes.rationale: Both FrameBinding constructors and side_identity now retain code_base.ref as well as every other repository/tree/commit/ref and conversion input. All eight independently replayed commit/ref mutations are stale, and foreign retry refuses; focused tests cover task/leaf/number/repositories/conversion and both constructors. No competing comparison namespace is introduced.
Composed CODE acceptance: original full packet/earlier closures retained from A4, and final F05/F10/F16 residuals closed on exact A5. No memory verdict or installed/UI claim.

Ordinary, resumed and symlink reads are streamed with measured consumption; an offset beyond MAX_SCAN_BYTES now refuses before any blob read (independent actualRead=0). Resumed prefix work is deducted from the finite scan budget. Packet path/collection caps, relationship path/byte/depth/page caps, bounded ls-tree streaming and a per-walk indexed lookup remain enforced; two-size and boundary tests pass. This credits bounded legitimate investigation, not unlimited-store-reader behavior owned by F10.

1.note: Packet assembly copies the comparison owner's sides instead of inventing them, and fills every collection or names why it is missing.

2.note: A packet read as evidence of another comparison is refused on the owner's full identity.

3.note: Supplied populations are bounded before the packet is assembled.

4.note: A skipped collection is carried as not selected or not read, with its reason.
